name.es: Contacto de cierre (normalmente abierto), símbolo general

description.en: Contact that closes when the device operates. Belongs to a parent device (relay, contactor, switch). Note: The blade is drawn open (NO) in the unoperated state.
description.es: Contacto que cierra al accionarse el aparato. Pertenece a un aparato principal (relé, contactor, interruptor). Nota: La cuchilla se dibuja abierta (NA) en estado no accionado.

iec60617.iec_title_en: Make contact, general symbol; Switch, general symbol

note.en: Contacts carry the letter of their parent device (e.g. K1, KM1).
note.es: Los contactos llevan la letra de su aparato principal (p. ej. K1, KM1).

geometry.grid: 1 unit = one symbol grid step; origin top-left, y down; scale to the drawing standard in use
